mentions.name: Focusapp
mentions.description: A personal productivity app that mirrors the contents of a file (a TODO list and other info) on your phone, with the option to make a call with Grok to brainstorm specifics. It is designed to remove any friction possible to make focusing easier.
mentions.problem: Friction makes it hard to stay focused; the app aims to remove any friction possible to make focus easier.
